scope: 100 distinct named household and everyday-life products with categorized Amazon affiliate recommendations

benchmarks.name: ThisIsWhyImBroke
benchmarks.observed: Category/recipient/scenario guides and short named product cards connect discovery with merchant actions. Saved counts and prices are their own published fields, not verified performance.
benchmarks.adopt: Scene-based category navigation, concise use case and one clear outbound action per card.
benchmarks.do_not_copy: Product photographs, current or historical prices, save counts, rankings or novelty claims. Some guide dates are years old.

benchmarks.name: Wirecutter
benchmarks.observed: Official policy describes editorial/testing standards and independent recommendations with affiliate disclosure. This is a stated process, not access to current internal conversion data.
benchmarks.adopt: Explain who a product may suit and what to check or skip, with traceable sources.
benchmarks.do_not_copy: Hands-on testing claims, best-product rankings or assumed traffic/CVR.

catalog_sources: Each of 100 actual records in sites/thedollscout/content/amazon-products.json includes its own primary source and checked date. The source file is internal build input; human cards and AI-readable mirrors expose appropriate source references without tracked merchant links.
link_caveat: Manufacturer/model identity confirmation is distinct from Amazon listing availability. Most outgoing links are labelled brand/model searches, not verified exact ASIN offers.

link_modes.US: 2 existing exact ASIN identities +98 explicitly labelled model searches
link_modes.local_availability: unverified; identity/source confirmation does not establish current Amazon inventory

inventory_validation.other_products_link_mode: Explicit brand/model Amazon search; no claim of local availability
inventory_validation.limitations: Some official model references are historical catalogs or support pages; access limits and catalog dates are retained in sourceEvidence, not presented as current stock.
